SCO Condemns Nuclear Threats, Iran Faces International Scrutiny

The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) has adopted a stance on nuclear security, condemning threats of nuclear weapon use. This comes as Iran faces renewed international pressure, including a contentious vote at the UN ahead of the General Assembly concerning its nuclear program. Separately, the US has reportedly launched new actions against Iran, which in turn fired on a US base in Jordan. The SCO's position on nuclear security was highlighted during its meetings.
